targets.old_statement: A Provisional License holder may drive unsupervised from 12:00 midnight to 5:00 a.m. only when going to, from or during a job.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A Provisional License holder may drive unsupervised from twelve midnight to five a.m. only when going to, from or during a job.
targets.statement: Between twelve midnight and five a.m., unsupervised provisional driving is permitted only for qualifying work, organized volunteer, official school, or participating athletic travel.
